a diet that is high in fat, low in vegetables, and high in calories is a major cause of colorectal cancer and probably also of breast cancer and prostate cancer.

we need to eat a diet rich in fruits and vegetables, whole grains, and nuts. And we should avoid eating processed meat, sugary drinks, and refined carbohydrates, such as white flour and white rice.

the best thing you can do to prevent cancer is to eat a plant-based diet, which is high in vegetables, fruits, whole grains, and legumes, and low in meat and animal products, and to be a healthy weight.
